title: Post-law cross-owner private imports in canonical M05
finding: M05 imports M07.contracts.InputStateFacts and M08.contracts EligibilityContext/FactAuthority/PosturePermission. The imports were introduced by commit 7ff10db after the public-seam law commit 3876f17.
recommended_disposition: Expose the required contract types intentionally through the owner public APIs or replace them with a narrower public carrier; import only the public owner seam.

title: Architecture readiness probe does not enforce the public-seam law
finding: foundation_readiness_probe validates owner direction and prefix-based exceptions only. It returned PASS with zero dependency violations while F-01 remains present. alpha_current contains no family traced to the 11.12.2 public-export proposition.
recommended_disposition: Add a current blocking architecture-boundary family that resolves public exports and rejects newly introduced private cross-owner imports, with explicit exceptions only for accepted evidence/transaction ports.

title: Blueprint status table is partly stale against later accepted control state
finding: Surface 5.17 still says declared-environment closure, proof isolation and aggregate promotion are incomplete, while later testing authority and CI define and execute them. The working blueprint itself warns that earlier snapshot wording is not current execution authority.
recommended_disposition: Replace or explicitly supersede the stale 5.17 status note with a current evidence-bounded statement; retain architecture-level proof gap until F-02 is closed.

title: AWS lineage is absent from the admitted external-source decision register
finding: The 432-line admitted register contains Google, Microsoft and IBM lineage but no AWS/Amazon Web Services entry. Official AWS material strongly corroborates bounded contexts, hexagonal ports/adapters, anti-corruption layers, incremental migration and layered CI testing.
recommended_disposition: Admit AWS only as corroborating lineage with project-specific adaptation and rejected interpretations; do not retroactively claim AWS originated NVDA-specific surfaces/modules.

title: Surfaces and modules are explicitly separated
finding: The blueprint defines 18 responsibility surfaces and 16 ownership modules, states the map is many-to-many and forbids treating package labels as ownership proof.
recommended_disposition: Retain this distinction in every architecture index and diagram.

title: Exact Python module graph is acyclic and dependency-conformant under declared exceptions
finding: Current probe returned 260 modules, 441 internal import edges, zero cycles, zero unresolved imports and zero unbounded dependency violations.
recommended_disposition: Retain exact module-level graph checks; do not substitute coarse package aggregation.

title: Coarse legacy package tangles remain visible
finding: Package aggregation shows contracts/packets/preparation and cognition/domain mutual dependency tangles. Exact Python modules remain acyclic; these are compatibility/responsibility tangles rather than runtime import cycles.
recommended_disposition: Remove only when the affected ownership cone is next migrated; do not force a whole-repository relocation.

title: Test admission and aggregate promotion mechanics are strong
finding: Every physical tier test must be admitted exactly once; proof block commands must equal registry-resolved paths; alpha_current must equal the complete current_blocking family set; CI executes promotion-gate after locked install. Current authority checks returned PASS.

title: Tier and lifecycle are orthogonal and easily misreported
finding: There are 186 files physically under Tier A but only 21 current-blocking Tier A paths. The machine model prevents folder-based admission, but human summaries that report Tier A alone are misleading.
recommended_disposition: Every report should show tier + lifecycle + current promotion membership, never folder count alone.

title: Current full functional test outcomes were not executed in this audit
finding: The audit executed structural/admission checks and the readiness probe, not make promotion-gate, make test, or the physical Tier A/B/C suites. Historical receipts are not substituted for a current run.
recommended_disposition: Treat functional greenness as Unknown for this audit; this does not affect the structural findings above.
